summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FASE F user stories US3, US11, US12 (previously untested in iteration 182). All three user stories are FULLY FUNCTIONAL. Backend: 68/68 POC tests PASS (F0-C entity scoping 27/27 + US3/US11/US12 41/41). Frontend: All UI elements, data-testids, Indonesian labels, and interactions working correctly. Movement type filtering, document tracing, and R&D product lifecycle blocking all operational.

notes.details: Product RND-KTN-150 correctly shows lifecycle badge, not-orderable notice with R&D flow explanation, blocked add-to-cart button, and QuickView modal with detailed blocking reason. Control product BTK-MEGA-001 is orderable.

Mutasi tab accessible via inventory-tab-ledger, shows Indonesian movement types (Ambil Bahan Sample, Hasil Produksi, etc.), sample filter works (39→1 mutasi), reset works, no English codes visible to users.

Document trace accessible via Pusat Dokumen (hub-tab-doc-trace) and Master Pembelian (contract-trace buttons). Shows complete chain: SPEC→SMP→SCT with Indonesian labels. Node clicking changes anchor, multi-level tracing works.
